notes.title: Demo v1.1.4 Patch
notes.content:
v1.1.4 patch notes
[list]
[*] ported game to Godot 4.4
[*] player vessels will now look in the direction of certain things when near them (like NPCs, props, menus, etc.)
   - they will also look at the camera if you stand still while holstered
[*] some NPCs will look at the player when they are near
[*] Komi will now look in the direction of nearby enemies
[*] modified non-erotic jiggle physics for certain characters (i.e. Aqua's Tail, Moffy's Anntennae, Taffy's Hair)
[*] visual changes while Player is holstered
    - crosshair will not appear
    - player will rotate towards where they are looking instead of which way the camera is facing
[*] fixed Moffy's Mothsune skin appearing invisible
[*] fixed certain characters having face warping
[*] fixed first person camera being positioned within vivian's boobs
[*] fixed Rainbow Potion persisting after drinking a Mundane potion and it affecting other models
[*] debloated some project files to increase performance
[/list]
Godot 4.4 released a few days ago which added some neat new features, I implemented a few of them into this patch as well as some other bug fixes

lmk if you run into anything weird as a result of this patch, had to rework some stuff that broke from upgrading versions so hopefully it works 🤞

notes.title: Demo v1.1.2 Patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*] added Rainbow Potion
- this gives your default skin a random color in certain areas
[*] added a cool new screen transition effect
[*] Biospheres mission changes
- smaller map, decreased kill quota from 7 to 3, and added hoverbikes
[*] added notification for Weapon Crafting after collecting materials
[*] fixed missing aqua animations
[*] fixed not being able to reselect Boss Battle missions
[*] fixed kills, deaths, and loot collected stats being incorrect on the mission end screen
[*] fixed some HQ npcs not having talking face textures
[*] typo fixes
[/list]
did you know that lil dude appears in almost every map in the game?
here's a handy guide if you want to seek him out:

notes.title: Solace Inc. 2 Demo is now available for Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[h3]Solace Inc 2 Demo[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3458240/Solace_Inc_2_Demo/

The Solace Inc. 2 Demo is now live for Steam Next Fest! This demo contains everything that's been added up to this point, which includes a dozen playable characters, a handful of maps, and a bunch of weapons, hats, and skins to unlock and use!

If you have any feedback or run into any issues you can DM me on Discord (@aplove) or on Bluesky (aplovestudio.bsky.social) and I'll get to work as soon as possible

Thank you all for checking out the game, if you liked the demo please leave a review and wishlist the full game, it would help out a ton 🙏
